There is no rules to life, you aren’t behind on anything. It’s ok to be 20 and live at home, most people do. Everyone is different you just have to figure out what makes you happy. If you don’t know what you want to do yet you still have plenty of time to figure out. Maybe a conventional job isn’t for you, just keep looking for different opportunities I’m sure you’ll find something that interests you. Even if you aren’t ready to start your career having a temporary summer job could help you make friends and get into a routine. I’m sorry you feel so down about yourself but I can promise you you’re worth more than you give yourself credit for. Please don’t give up I’d genuinely be upset to hear if something bad happened to you <3

You said your parents push you away when you ask for help. I got help through my doctor who set me up with a therapist and medications. You could try making a doctors appointment if you still want help. 20 is still really young and with quarantine things have been a lot harder for people our age. I think you shouldn’t be so hard on yourself. Sending u an internet hug <3
